script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars in Virgo is squaring your ruling planet Uranus in Gemini, igniting friction between your 8th House of shared resources and 5th House of passion. This tense aspect pulls your air-sign intellect into confrontation over intimacy and creative control. As a fixed Air sign, your usual detachment becomes both shield and trigger. If you're taken, watch for power struggles with your partner over shared finances; the square demands clear boundaries. Singles should attract a free-spirited air sign who stimulates your Uranian mind via witty debate. Your 10th House of career receives a supportive sextile from the Sun in Cancer, suggesting a nurturing mentor boosts your status. Avoid speculative 8th-House investments amid the Mars tension. An unexpected blessing comes through a spontaneous invitation to a network that expands your income. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
